programs.title: The Last of Us 2
programs.desc: Five years have passed since Ellie (Bella Ramsey) and Joel (Pedro Pascal)'s dangerous journey.They both still function in a world whose rules are dictated by a pandemic caused by cordyceps.At first it is easier for them because they live in the city of Jackson, where they have many friends.However, when the man is caught up in the revenge of Abby Anderson (Kaitlyn Dever), the daughter of a doctor from Salt Lake City, and the soldiers from her unit - the Wolves - Ellie has no choice but to leave the town to find her and retaliate.She is accompanied on a dangerous expedition by her friend, Dina (Isabela Moner).

programs.title: True Blood
programs.desc: Andy discovers a bag in his car with a dead body falling out of it.Bill will have a difficult conversation with Jessica.The girl cannot accept the strict rules in his house.Lafayette is locked in the basement.He tries to stay calm, but the prospect of spending another few weeks in this place terrifies him.Maryann goes to the police station to pick up Tara.Sookie shows up at Bill's house.She wants to talk to her boyfriend.They are interrupted by scantily clad Jessica.The news that Bill turned her into a vampire devastates Sookie.

programs.desc: Japanese scientists are developing a way to produce artificial blood.Thanks to this, vampires can come out of hiding and become full members of society.However, this raises a lot of social unrest.The sudden disappearance of Godric, one of the oldest and most influential vampires, causes massive chaos.Representatives of the Christian organization Community of the Sun are suspected of his kidnapping.Eric - Godric's creator - enlists Sookie's help.In his opinion, the girl's extraordinary abilities may be useful in finding the vampire.

programs.title: Killer Heat
programs.desc: Greece.American Nick Bali (Joseph Gordon-Levitt) is hired to investigate the circumstances of the death of young shipping magnate Leo Vardakis (Richard Madden) in Crete.The deceased's sister-in-law, Penelope Vardakis (Shailene Woodley), does not believe the official police report.A private detective discovers that sunny landscapes hide many dark secrets and anyone can be a suspect.He discovers further facts about the rich and influential Vardakis family, as well as the brothers' complicated relationship.Adaptation of the story "The Jealousy Man" by Jo Nesbo.

programs.title: The Fourth Wall
programs.desc: The year 1982, war-torn Lebanon.Theater director Georges (Laurent Lafitte), in order to keep his promise to his terminally ill friend, goes to Beirut to implement a risky project.He intends to put "Antigone" on the front line to guarantee a moment of peace for the parties to the conflict.The show will feature actors involved in fighting, belonging to various political and religious factions.Marwan (Simon Abkarian) becomes a guide in an unknown city, who explains the background of the dispute to the foreigner and becomes a link with the locals.Soon Georges faces the brutal realities of war.The plans are also complicated by the feelings he has for one of the actresses, Imane (Manal Issa).

programs.title: French Courier from Liberty, Kansas Evening Sun
programs.desc: The 20th-century fictional French town of Ennui-sur-Blasé is the headquarters of "Kurier Francuski", a magazine published by American emigrants.When a respected editor, Kansas native Arthur Howitzer Jr (Bill Murray), dies, the entire team gathers to write an obituary.Their memories make up four colorful stories.Herbsaint Sazerac (Owen Wilson), an avid cyclist, recalls dark stories related to the city, showing its dangerous alleys.J.K.L.Berensen (Tilda Swinton) presents the story of an insane painter, Moses Rosenthaler (Benicio del Toro), who creates from behind prison bars.A brilliant artist is involved in an affair with a guard and his muse (Lea Seydoux).An art dealer, Julian Cadazio (Adrien Brody), tries to make money from his paintings.Lucinda Krementz (Frances McDormand) tells the story of a fiery student rebellion led by Zeffirelli (Timothée Chalamet).It is also a story of beautiful love and tragic death on the barricades.Roebuck Wright (Jeffrey Wright) presents a story about drugs, kidnappings and refined cuisine, and its hero will be Lieutenant Nescaffier (Steve Park).Another visual masterpiece from Wes Anderson is a tribute to old-style journalism.The elaborate, nostalgic anthology is inspired by the famous weekly "The New Yorker" and the personalities who made up its editorial staff.

programs.title: Your Monster
programs.desc: Actress Laura (Melissa Barrera) was supposed to become a star of the stage and live happily with the director of the show, Jacob (Edmund Donovan), but her beloved dumped her and took the role away.The devastated woman returns to her family home, where she spends all day in a bathrobe and crying.Her wailing gets on the nerves of the monster (Tommy Dewey), who has been living in the closet for years.The monster gives Laura two weeks to move out and threatens bloody revenge.Over time, however, an extraordinary bond develops between them, which helps Laura open her heart and follow her dreams.

programs.title: A Royal Christmas Ballet
programs.desc: Former ballet dancer Carrie (Brittany Underwood) is to prepare a performance of "The Nutcracker" on the occasion of a visit from a foreign delegation.While working on the play, she becomes involved in an affair.
